# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

    return -float(node.id)

    return out

# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_after = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
    peak = max(cpu_after, mem_after)
    if peak > 0.85:
        return -1000000.0

    fill = peak
    efficiency = 1.0 - min(node.power_idle_w / 120.0, 1.0)

    weighted = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    edges = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        source = ctx.graph.src[e]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                rate = ctx.graph.rate[e]
                weighted = weighted + rate * node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                weight = weight + rate

    proximity = 0.5
    if weight > 0.0:
        mean_lat = weighted / weight
        proximity = 1.0 - min(mean_lat / 45.0, 1.0)

    suspend_bonus = 0.0
    if not node.suspendable:
        suspend_bonus = 0.1

    return fill * 0.5 + efficiency * 0.3 + proximity * 0.2 + suspend_bonus

def find_best_target(state: ClusterState, pod: Pod, current_node: int) -> int:
    best_j = -1
    best_fill = -1.0
    num_nodes = len(state.nodes)
    for j in range(num_nodes):
        if j != current_node:
            target = state.nodes[j]
            if not target.suspended:
                cpu_after = target.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
                mem_after = target.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
                if cpu_after <= target.cpu_capacity and mem_after <= target.mem_capacity:
                    cpu_after_util = float(cpu_after) / float(max(target.cpu_capacity, 1))
                    mem_after_util = float(mem_after) / float(max(target.mem_capacity, 1))
                    peak = max(cpu_after_util, mem_after_util)
                    if peak <= 0.85 and peak > best_fill:
                        best_fill = peak
                        best_j = j
    return best_j

def moves_for_node(state: ClusterState, node_index: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    node = state.nodes[node_index]
    if node.suspended:
        return out
    cpu_util = float(node.cpu_allocated) / float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_util = float(node.mem_allocated) / float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    max_util = max(cpu_util, mem_util)
    if max_util > 0.3:
        return out
    num_pods = len(state.pods)
    for p in range(num_pods):
        pod = state.pods[p]
        if pod.current_node == node_index and not pod.stateful and not pod.has_pdb:
            best_j = find_best_target(state, pod, node_index)
            if best_j >= 0:
                out.append(move_pod(pod.id, best_j))
    return out

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out
    moved = 0
    num_nodes = len(state.nodes)
    for i in range(num_nodes):
        if moved < budget:
            node_moves = moves_for_node(state, i)
            for m in range(len(node_moves)):
                if moved < budget:
                    out.append(node_moves[m])
                    moved = moved + 1
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
